groups.observations: Elevated loading scene. Frame 1 has editorial title, circle and arrow obscuring targets. Frame 9 has a large censorship patch. Frames 6-8 require tight visible pedestrian, forklift and cargo boxes; inspect driver visibility rather than infer occupation.
Elevated CCTV, wrapped load, outside pedestrians and truck. Timestamp overlays require crop assessment and joint box transformation. Manual pallet truck must not be labelled forklift.

Vertical footage with black side borders. Foreground person at stationary industrial equipment is class 0, not class 2 merely because operating equipment. Fixed roller machine is not class 1. A forklift becomes visible behind the panels in later frames; avoid inferring hidden people.
Elevated daylight yard, blue pallet load and partially clipped forklifts; subtitles cover lower targets. Review crop feasibility and visible load units individually.
Elevated daylight yard, orange forklift and carried load. Subtitles overlap lower vehicle; do not infer driver boxes from a dark cab.

grouping_policy: These are observed scene clusters, not proof of independent source events. Keep all related compilation footage together conservatively until original recordings establish independence.
new_night_yard_comparison: The downloaded night-yard footage was not observed in these 21 compilation frames. This does not establish absence from the remaining originals or from edgev1 training data.
remaining_work: Check original annotations, resolve ambiguities using source footage, transform any crop boxes, render and individually review overlays. No approved-image count changes from this triage.
